name: openzoo memory
author: stacc
description: Ask your own machine. Semantic recall over a holographically-bound corpus, answered by a leCore daemon running on localhost — no account, no network, nothing leaves the box unless you opt in.

barWidget.description: Semantic search over your bound corpus, local by default.

schema.label: leCore daemon
schema.description: Local holographic memory daemon. Default is loopback — nothing leaves this machine.

schema.label: Daemon token
schema.description: Bearer token the local daemon expects.

schema.label: Context id
schema.description: Which bound corpus to search (ctx_...). Required — the daemon has no list endpoint.

schema.label: Retrieval breadth
schema.description: Slices returned per query. Breadth is the real quality knob.

schema.label: openzoo key (optional)
schema.description: LEAVE EMPTY FOR FULLY LOCAL. Setting an ozk_live_ key opts in to hosted models and cross-machine corpora, and sends queries off this machine.
